HERO.SUBTITLE: No more wondering if a registration went through. Learnify tracks every formation from submission to validation, so status is always one glance away — for participants and administrators alike.

STORY.TEXT: Every formation on Learnify carries the same structure — a theme, a mode, a schedule — so what you see when browsing is exactly what you get when you show up. Registrations are tracked from submission to validation, with a status that updates automatically instead of living in someone's inbox.

OLD.ONE: Sign-up sheets scattered across email and paper
OLD.TWO: No way to confirm if a registration was received
OLD.THREE: Schedule changes communicated after the fact
OLD.FOUR: Mode of delivery unclear until session day

NEW.ONE: One place to browse, register, and track formations
NEW.TWO: Registration status visible the moment it's submitted
NEW.THREE: Schedule and room details attached to every formation
NEW.FOUR: Mode — in person, online, or hybrid — set upfront

FAQ.TITLE: Good to know
FAQ.A1: Browse formations, pick one that fits your schedule, and submit your registration. You'll see its status update as it's reviewed.
FAQ.Q2: What's the difference between the three modes?
FAQ.A2: In person means physical training rooms. Online is fully remote. Hybrid combines both across a formation's sessions.
FAQ.Q3: Can I track my registration after registering?
FAQ.A3: Yes — your profile shows every formation you've registered for, along with its current status.
FAQ.Q4: Who do I contact if something looks wrong?
FAQ.A4: Reach out through the Contact page and an administrator will follow up directly.

PRIVACY.TITLE: Privacy Policy
PRIVACY.SUBTITLE: This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal data when using our platform.

INFORMATION.TITLE: Information We Collect
INFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: We collect personal information such as your name, email address, encrypted password, profile details, and learning activity. We may also collect technical information including your device type, browser, and usage logs.

DATA_USAGE.TITLE: How We Use Your Data
DATA_USAGE.DESCRIPTION: Your data is used to create and manage your account, provide access to training programs, monitor your progress, and continuously improve our platform.

PROTECTION.TITLE: Data Protection
PROTECTION.DESCRIPTION: We use secure authentication, encrypted passwords, and protected databases to safeguard your personal information. Access is limited to authorized administrators only.

COOKIES.TITLE: Cookies
COOKIES.DESCRIPTION: Cookies help us improve your experience, remember your preferences, and analyze platform performance. You may disable cookies at any time through your browser settings.

THIRD_PARTY.TITLE: Third-Party Services
THIRD_PARTY.DESCRIPTION: We may rely on trusted third-party services for authentication and analytics. These providers follow strict privacy and security standards.

RIGHTS.TITLE: Your Rights
RIGHTS.DESCRIPTION: You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal data. You may also request a copy of the information associated with your account.

CONTACT.TITLE: Contact
CONTACT.DESCRIPTION: If you have any questions regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact our support team.
